id: \bIf you get a Pokémon in a trade it may not listen to you. Having badges helps with that problem.
en: \bIf you get a Pokémon in a trade it may not listen to you. Having badges helps with that problem.
it: \bSe ricevi un Pokémon con uno scambio, potrebbe non obbedirti. Avere delle medaglie aiuta a risolvere il problema.

id: \bI can teach your Pokémon a powerful fighting move, Superpower.
en: \bI can teach your Pokémon a powerful fighting move, Superpower.
it: \bPosso insegnare ai tuoi Pokémon una potente mossa di tipo Lotta: Troppoforte.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \rYou can identify Pokémon you get in trades by their ID Numbers.
en: \rYou can identify Pokémon you get in trades by their ID Numbers.
it: \rPuoi riconoscere i Pokémon ottenuti negli scambi dal loro N. ID.
